sites.name: tiltmeter
sites.note: Not yet deployed (SPEC §12 M0-M2). Every family for this site is skipped reasonCode:not_published by config, before any HTTP request is made — never by probing and interpreting a response. Verified live 2026-08-08: this shared *.vercel.app subdomain already resolves to an unrelated third-party project, so a response-driven skip would risk publishing a claim about someone else's software (SPEC §1 non-goal 1).

sites.name: dogwatch
sites.note: Deployed at this URL since M6. Self-watch is nevertheless OFF (deployed:false), so every family here is skipped reasonCode:not_published by config before any request — turning it on changes what the nightly run does and is a deliberate, separate step. Unlike the other four, this subdomain is NOT a third-party squat: the bare dogwatch.vercel.app is, which is why the URL above is the real alias read from `vercel inspect` rather than the guessable one.
